
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
gt(head(rhinovirus))

weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
))  +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Temp (C)") +
  ggtitle("Temperature by Date")
  
health <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
ggplot(health, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
))  +
  geom_line(colour = "green") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Metric") +
  ggtitle("Percentage of positive PCR test results for rhinovirus")
